steps.en: Newly received submissions are collected for checking
steps.id: Pengajuan yang baru diterima dikumpulkan untuk dicek

steps.en: A notice with an active permanent suspension goes to manual review
steps.id: Notice dengan suspension permanen aktif masuk manual review

steps.en: A furnished person on the HST list goes to manual review
steps.id: Orang yang di-furnish dan ada di daftar HST masuk manual review

steps.en: Foreign or passport IDs always go to manual review
steps.id: ID asing atau paspor selalu masuk manual review

steps.en: A notice that moved past a furnishable stage goes to manual review
steps.id: Notice yang sudah lewat stage furnishable masuk manual review

steps.en: Offender status and existing hirer or driver are checked
steps.id: Status offender dan hirer atau driver yang sudah ada dicek

steps.en: A second submission on the same notice goes to manual review
steps.id: Pengajuan kedua pada notice yang sama masuk manual review

steps.en: When every check passes the submission is approved by the system
steps.id: Bila semua cek lolos pengajuan disetujui oleh sistem

steps.en: A failed check places the submission on the officer's list
steps.id: Cek yang gagal menaruh pengajuan di daftar officer
